title: HR Business Partner - Hyderabad, IN
description:
**Fieldpiece Instruments**, a privately held US company, is hiring a **Human Resources Business Partner** to open our new office in Hyderabad, Telangana. Reporting to the CHRO in the US, you’ll be the first and only HR professional in India and be responsible for building this office from the ground up – managing the office, working with a local service firm for payroll and compliance, and partnering with US\-based managers to hire 20\+ high\-caliber technical professionals in the first year. This is a founding HR Business Partner opportunity.


If you’ve successfully built and scaled India operations for a US\-based company before — and know exactly what “day zero to structured growth” looks like — we want to speak with you. This role is ideal for a confident, strategic, execution\-focused HR leader who thrives in ambiguity, builds structure, and enjoys partnering across time zones.
Fieldpiece is a thriving team of innovators \- committed to pushing boundaries and celebrating curiosity. We’ve been providing HVACR professionals with rugged, feature\-rich tools like meters, manifolds, leak detectors, and more since 1990\. Fieldpiece leads the industry in the way we think, work, collaborate, and remain laser\-focused on creating products that empower HVACR professionals – today and tomorrow.
**What You Will Own**


**Build the India HR Foundation and Office*** Partner with local HR/payroll vendors and legal counsel to develop India\-specific HR policies to ensure full compliance with Indian labor laws, statutory requirements, and local regulations and alignment with global standards and Fieldpiece values
* Act as a trusted advisor to the US\-based CHRO and leadership team – aligning India talent strategy with global business objectives
* Implement HR systems and processes




**Scale the Hyderabad Team*** Participate in workforce planning with US and India leadership to hire \~22 professionals in the first year (engineering, software, QA, technical roles)
* Build strong recruiting pipelines and employer branding locally
* Drive structured onboarding and performance processes
* Establish a high\-performance, inclusive culture and drive engagement initiatives and retention strategies
* Coach managers and leaders and serve as the go\-to HR partner for all employee relations matters

**What You Bring*** 10\+ years in HR, including senior HR Business Partner or HR Leader roles
* Proven experience building or scaling India operations for a US or multinational company with a focus on engineering or technology
* Expertise in Telangana employment law and statutory compliance
* Experience managing a new office and HR operations as the sole HR leader
* Fluent, professional English (written and verbal)
* Experience with Workday or other global HCM platforms


**Our values drive everything we do and our culture.**
**We are a TRIBE.*** Our collective growth starts with individual growth.
* We are fully engaged and empowered, collaborating to achieve our common mission.
* Our people are central in making Fieldpiece the best place we will work, ever.


**We do the UPFRONT HOMEWORK.*** We are prepared before coming together to move forward effectively.
* We begin with the end in mind by understanding The Why upfront, visualizing, researching, and acting.
* We address obstacles head\-on with creativity, grit and tenacity, while having fun along the way.


**We deliver the RIGHT STUFF.*** We deliver innovative solutions by seeing the world through the eyes of our customers.
* Our culture of purposeful critical thinking leads to greatness now, rather than perfection never.


**We earn TRUST.*** We prove our credibility, reliability, and genuine interest in others to build lasting relationships.
* Our tribe, partners, end users, suppliers and channel partners can rely on us to listen, act with integrity, and deliver quality.

The HR Systems Product Owner is responsible for the strategic design, implementation, and continuous optimization of the organization's global human resources technology ecosystem. This role ensures data integrity, global compliance, and a seamless end\-user experience for a distributed workforce.

**Responsibilities**

* **System Architecture \& Strategy:** Lead the internal HR Systems roadmap, prioritizing feature releases and configurations that align with global business scaling.
* **Ecosystem Integration:** Act as the primary architect for data flows between platforms to ensure a "single source of truth."
* **Process Optimization:** Design and document automated workflows for the full employee lifecycle to minimize manual intervention.
* **Global Compliance:** Configure systems to meet regional regulatory requirements, including GDPR/data privacy standards, localized tax logic, and labor law configurations.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Translate complex business requirements from HR, Finance, and Legal into technical specifications and functional system improvements.
* **Data Governance:** Maintain high standards of data quality through regular audits, validation rules, and robust reporting/analytics.

* **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in HRIS/HR Systems management, specifically within the **Workday** ecosystem.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Demonstrated experience with various Workday module within the HCM Suite.
* **Integration Knowledge:** Proven track record of managing data flow between Workday and third\-party systems
* **Global Exposure:** Experience supporting a workforce across multiple countries and time zones.
* **Remote Working:** Must have a dedicated workspace with reliable high\-speed internet. Ability to occasionally attend meetings outside of standard local business hours to coordinate with global team members.

* Expert\-level analytical and problem\-solving skills within enterprise software.

**Role Responsibilities****We are looking for a strategic and results\-driven Talent Acquisition Lead to steer our campus strategy \& business hiring engine. Your goal is to build a diverse, high\-performing workforce that scales with our 2026 growth commitments.**

* Create innovative engagement strategies to nurture talent pipelines.
* Represent the company at external forums, universities, and industry events.
* Build and strengthen the employer brand to attract top talent.

Present monthly "Talent Health Reports" to leadership, highlighting metrics like Quality\-of\-Hire and Offer Acceptance Rates.  
*

* **12\+ years in full\-cycle recruitment, with at least 5 years in a Lead or Senior capacity.**
**\- Tech Savvy: Expert\-level knowledge of modern ATS platforms and AI\-sourcing assistants.****\- Enterprise Thinking, Exceptional "persuasion" skills—you can navigate complex counter\-offers and "sell" the company vision to passive candidates.****\- Analytical Mindset: You enjoy digging into data to find out why a certain stage of the funnel is leaking candidates.****\- Problem Solving \& Founders Mindset to solve same problems in different ways.**  

**Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, Psychology, or equivalent practical experience.**  

  

**Skills \& Competencies:****\- Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills with a focus on data\-driven decision\-making.****\- Strong interpersonal and communication skills (story telling) with the ability to build relationships and influence across all levels of the organization.****\- Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects with high autonomy and accountability.**

title: Senior Workday Solution Architect - Global HR (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


This role sits within the **Digital Transformation function of the People \& Organization department**. You will play a critical role in shaping and delivering complex global HR technology initiatives by combining deep HR tech expertise, solution architecture, and strong project execution capabilities.



You will design scalable HR system architectures, lead global system and vendor transitions, and ensure our HR technology landscape remains compliant, future\-ready, and aligned to our operating model.



You will design scalable HR system architectures, service delivery \& operating models, lead global system and vendor transitions, and ensure our HR technology landscape remains compliant, future\-ready, and aligned to our operating model.



This is a **1\-year fixed\-term role**, based in **Gurugram (hybrid model)**, our India hub, covering a global scope.


**About the Role**


* **Automation:** Strong hands\-on experience in Scripting process/task automations using niche technologies like UiPath StudioX, Power Automate, Python, GenAI LLMs and ability to build API/SFTP integrations and building middleware solutions
* **Solution Architecture Design:** Analyze HR processes \& system landscape reviews using BPMN \& lean methodologies, identify inefficiencies, and design scalable to\-be processes and HR Tech system landscapes
* **Tech Evaluation \& Adoption**: Scout emerging HR technology solutions and partner with FlixTech to design workflows, evaluate integration options (APIs, SFTP, etc.) and build system architecture designs. Create data\-driven business cases for project budget allocation.
* **Technical Project Delivery**: Lead delivery of high\-impact global HR Tech projects with multiple workstreams (scope, plan, RAID, benefits, budgets, vendors) and building risk management frameworks using Jira
* **Project Reporting \& Governance:** Maintain BPMN process documentation, embed processes in HR service delivery model, run project governance \& stakeholder bodies, set internal control points \& risk frameworks, compliance and data privacy frameworks as per internal and external regulatory standards


**About You**


* **7\+ years of experience in HR Tech transformation** as a Senior Business Analyst, Solution Architect, or RPA Automation Developer
* Strong hands\-on experience delivering global **Workday architecture implementations**, system redesigns, or HRIS architecture transformations (Workday is mandatory)
* Experience with system architecture redesigns, integrations (API, SFTP, middleware), cloud environments, and data flows
* Proven experience driving global HR tech initiatives with multi\-country stakeholders in vendor\-heavy ecosystems
* Hands\-on Jira portfolio management, Confluence documentation, BPMN modelling, test strategy design (SIT/UAT)
* University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology, HR Tech, or related field
* Certifications in architecture, RPA, Automation or project management (PMP / SAFe / Scrum / Six Sigma/UiPath or similar)


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Travel perks**: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere**: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 30 days per year.
* **Hybrid work model**: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* **Wellbeing support**: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* **Learning \& Development**: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* **Mentoring Program**: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career



**Why Join Flix?**



At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.



If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

I. HR Generalist Operations (Approx. 75%)

	+ Employee Relations: Manage and resolve moderate to complex employee relations issues, disciplinary actions, and grievances, ensuring all actions are documented and adhere to the principles of labor code and culture of Onemagnify.
	+ Payroll Input Management: Coordinate with Finance/Payroll vendors to ensure error\-free salary processing, including TDS and bonus calculations.
	+ Insurance Management: Oversee Group Medical Insurance (GMC) and Personal Accident insurance, assisting employees with claims and queries.
	+ HRIS (Workday) Mastery: Act as the system power user, ensuring data integrity, generating compliance and strategic HR reports, and driving automation and efficiency within the HRIS.
	+ Policy Management: Draft, update, and communicate internal HR policies and guidelines to ensure they remain current and aligned with the latest amendments to the Indian Labour Codes.

Prior industry experience is not required—a strong interest in mechanical systems and willingness to learn is most important.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in designing and assembling mechanical parts and moving mechanisms for robotic games

Create basic 3D CAD models and drawings with guidance

Work with motors, gears, linkages, frames, and actuators

Support prototyping, fabrication, and mechanical testing

Help with assembly, alignment, and troubleshooting

Coordinate with electronics and robotics teams for system integration

Assist during on\-site installations, events, and exhibitions

Learn and follow mechanical safety and quality standards

Who Can Apply

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech students or graduates in Mechanical Engineering or related fields

Freshers or candidates with 0–1 year of experience

Final\-year students seeking practical industry exposure

Candidates who enjoy hands\-on work, tools, and mechanical building

Learners who are curious, proactive, and detail\-oriented

Basic Skills Required (Training Will Be Provided)

Basic understanding of mechanisms and machine elements

Familiarity with any CAD software (SolidWorks / Fusion 360 / AutoCAD – basic level is sufficient)

Interest in robotics, automation, or mechanical systems

Willingness to learn fabrication and assembly processes

Good problem\-solving attitude

Added Advantage (Not Mandatory)

College projects in robotics, automation, or mechanical design

Exposure to 3D printing, laser cutting, CNC, or workshop tools

Basic understanding of mechanical–electrical system integration

What You Will Gain

Strong hands\-on experience in robotics and interactive systems

Opportunity to work on real products used in public installations

Practical exposure beyond classroom learning

Experience with events, exhibitions, and live system setups

Mentorship from experienced engineers

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher, Internship  
Contract length: 6 months

Pay: ₹2,000\.00 \- ₹5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Intern
description:
**At Pitney Bowes, we do the right thing, the right way. As a member of our team, you can too.**

  

We have amazing people who are the driving force, the inspiration and foundation of our company. Our thriving culture can be broken down into four components: **Client. Team. Win. Innovate.**


We actively look for prospects who:  

* Are passionate about client success.
* Enjoy collaborating with others.
* Strive to exceed expectations.
* Move boldly in the quest for superior and best in market solutions.
**Job Description:**

**Join Pitney Bowes as Intern**

**Years of Experience required\- Fresher**

**Job Location\-Noida**

**Impact**


We are looking for a highly motivated **Intern**/Associate who will contribute to building and enhancing our enterprise\-grade software applications. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about writing high\-quality code, building scalable systems, and leveraging cloud technologies to solve complex business problems.


**The Job**

* Participate in requirement analysis and technical design discussions for new features and platform enhancements.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable backend services and APIs.
* Write clean, modular, and well\-documented code following software engineering best practices.
* Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and third\-party systems.
* Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and Architecture teams to deliver high\-quality features.
* Work on API\-first and cloud\-native applications.
* Contribute to database design, optimization, and query development.
* Assist in containerization and deployment of applications to cloud platforms.
* Debug and troubleshoot production issues while ensuring performance and scalability.

**Qualifications \& Skills required**

* UG \- B.Tech/B.E. OR PG – M.S. / M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline.
* Knowledge of at least one Object oriented programming language like Java(spring\-boot, web services, multithreading).
* Basic knowledge of DB and SQL Queries (preferably mySQL)
* Knowledge of any cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus
* Knowledge of API Testing tool is required like postman, SoapUI etc.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes is a plus.
* Knowledge of Agile framework is a plus
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast paced, changing environment
* Strong customer focus, excellent problem solving, and analytical skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills

**About Pitney Bowes**


Pitney Bowes (NYSE:PBI) is a global technology company providing commerce solutions that power billions of transactions. Clients around the world, including 90 percent of the Fortune 500, rely on the accuracy and precision delivered by Pitney Bowes solutions, analytics, and APIs in the areas of ecommerce fulfillment, shipping and returns; cross\-border ecommerce; office mailing and shipping; presort services; and financing. For 100 years Pitney Bowes has been innovating and delivering technologies that remove the complexity of getting commerce transactions precisely right. For additional information visit Pitney Bowes at https://www.pitneybowes.com/in.

**We will:**

* Provide the will: opportunity to grow and develop your career
* Offer an inclusive environment that encourages diverse perspectives and ideas
* Deliver challenging and unique opportunities to contribute to the success of a transforming organization
* Offer comprehensive benefits globally **(****P****B Live Well**)


Pitney Bowes is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity and inclusiveness in the workplace.  

  

All interested individuals must apply online.

title: Process Trainee
description:
**1\. Answering Inbound Customer Calls**

Answering incoming customer calls is the primary responsibility of a call center employee at the entry level\-position of inbound call centers. When receiving inbound calls, they must provide accurate information about a company’s offerings, answer questions from prospects or current customers, resolve basic issues, and manage account inquiries.

An inbound call center representative may also be responsible for processing orders and payments, resolving billing and payment issues, managing cancellations, shipping, refunds, returns, and warranties, and properly logging customer data after each customer interaction.

To efficiently handle the inbound call volume and deliver an exceptional customer service experience, they should know how to start and end a call, follow call scripts, put a customer on hold, and transfer a call when the customer’s issue needs escalation.

**2\. Managing Customer Complaints**

A call center job requires agents to effectively manage complaints and deal with unhappy customers. Therefore, agents should be trained and equipped to solve customer problems quickly and efficiently and defuse conflicts before they turn into more challenging situations.

Agents must be able to demonstrate excellent listening skills, empathy, problem\-solving, and properly apologize. They also should know how to seamlessly escalate the issue to higher\-tier support if it cannot be resolved immediately, or if an agent doesn’t have the appropriate skill set or authority.

**3\. Troubleshooting and Follow\-ups**

In IT, tech, and SaaS companies, call center representatives can be involved in troubleshooting and resolving technical support issues customers may have with a company’s product or service. That can also include performing diagnostic tests, troubleshooting software installations, and assisting with setting up product features. Since complicated tech issues aren’t always resolved on the first contact, agents may also need to follow up with customers and update them on the progress of their queries.

**4\. Making Outbound Calls**

In outbound call centers, agents initiate calls to leads, prospects, or customers, rather than accepting incoming calls. These calls can have specific purposes ranging from cold calling, telemarketing sales, and proactive support to scheduling appointments, gathering feedback, and conducting market research.

* **Lead generation and sales:** Agents make large volumes of outbound calls to generate leads or sell a company’s products or services to existing clients.
* **Proactive customer service:** Agents reach out to customers proactively to address existing or potential issues before they become bigger problems.
* **Conducting market research:** Agents make outbound calls to conduct market research and gather insights about market trends and consumer preferences.
* **Collecting customer feedback:** Agents can be responsible for calling up the customers to gather feedback about the products or services they purchased.
* **Appointment scheduling:** Agents may call potential customers to schedule appointments and events with a business.
* **Debt collection:** Agents call customers who have overdue payments to negotiate payment plans, collect debts, and resolve other financial disputes.

Most outbound call center operations and agent workflows can be optimized through call center dialing tools such as AI\-powered auto dialers. Call center dialers automate the dialing process and enable agents to handle high outbound call volumes while increasing agent talk times and reducing agent idle times.

**5\. Up\-Selling and Cross\-Selling**

Up\-selling and cross\-selling are also among the common call center duties. During customer service interactions, agents can encourage customers to purchase a higher\-end version of a product or service they are already using (up\-sell) or offer a related or complementary product or service (cross\-sell). To do it efficiently, professionally, and in a non\-intrusive way, agents should have deep product knowledge and be able to communicate its benefits to customers.

title: HR Manager
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced HR Manager to join our team. The HR Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of human resources practices and processes. This includes recruiting, performance management, employee relations, compensation and benefits, compliance, training and development, and workforce planning. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and leadership skills, with a deep understanding of HR best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Recruitment \& Onboarding:**
* Manage full recruitment cycle, including job postings, sourcing candidates, conducting interviews, and facilitating selection processes.
* Ensure smooth onboarding of new employees, including documentation, training, and introduction to the company culture.
* **Employee Relations:**
* Serve as a point of contact for employees regarding HR policies, benefits, and any concerns.
* Resolve employee conflicts and address grievances in a fair and timely manner.
* Foster a positive and engaging work environment by promoting company culture and values.
* **Performance Management:**
* Implement and manage performance review systems, including setting performance goals, conducting evaluations, and providing feedback.
* Assist department heads in identifying skill gaps and developing training plans.
* **Compensation \& Benefits:**
* Oversee salary structure, benefits programs, and incentive plans.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and regulations, including payroll management and tax reporting.
* Regularly assess compensation and benefits structures to remain competitive in the market.
* **Training \& Development:**
* Identify training needs and organize internal/external learning and development programs for employees.
* Track employee progress and performance post\-training to ensure development goals are being met.
* **HR Policies \& Compliance:**
* Develop and maintain HR policies and procedures that comply with legal regulations and industry standards.
* Ensure adherence to all relevant labor laws and company regulations, including health and safety standards.
* Manage HR audits and maintain accurate records.
* **Employee Engagement \& Retention:**
* Lead initiatives aimed at improving employee engagement, satisfaction, and retention.
* Organize events, surveys, and feedback mechanisms to gauge employee morale.
* Develop strategies for enhancing employee motivation and maintaining a strong company culture.
* **Strategic HR Planning:**
* Collaborate with leadership in workforce planning and strategic HR decision\-making.
* Assist in developing long\-term HR goals aligned with company objectives.
* Lead change management initiatives as required.
* **Exit Management:**
* Oversee exit interviews, ensure proper documentation, and manage the offboarding process.
* Work with department heads to ensure smooth transitions and knowledge transfer during employee exits.

**Key Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master's preferred).
* Minimum of 5\-7 years of experience in HR management or related roles.
* Strong knowledge of labor laws, HR best practices, and regulations.
* Proven experience in recruitment, employee relations, and performance management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to develop and implement HR policies and procedures.
* High level of discretion and confidentiality.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in HR software and Microsoft Office Suite.

title: HR Manager
description:
**A bit about us**
------------------


Trek is an awesome place to work, with amazing benefits for all employees. We build only products we love, provide incredible hospitality to our customers, and change the world by getting more people on bikes. When you’re on our team, you’re taken care of, encouraged to learn and grow, and given lots of opportunities to do so. Give us your best, and we’ll give it right back. Sound pretty sweet? Then come join us!

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title: HR Manager**
=========================

**Location: Gurgaon, India**
============================

**Job type: Full time**
=======================

**Reports To: Country Head**
============================

**Work hours: min. 40 hours per week, Mon\-Fri, 3\-days Work from Office each week**
====================================================================================

**Role Overview**


The HR Manager will support and execute the Human Resources function for Trek India. This role requires a hands\-on professional who will personally manage and deliver core HR activities across the employee lifecycle while supporting strategic HR initiatives driven by Senior Leadership.


The HR Manager will be responsible for day\-to\-day HR operations, talent acquisition support, employee onboarding, training coordination, employee relations, HR data and compliance, and performance cycle administration. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being deeply involved in execution.

**Objectives of the role**

* Executing HR processes that support Trek India’s people strategy and business objectives.
* Managing operational HR activities including employee lifecycle management, HR documentation, HRIS updates, and compliance.
* Leading the talent acquisition \& independently handling offer negotiations.
* Leading onboarding, induction, and training coordination for all new hires.
* Driving employee engagement activities and supporting culture\-building initiatives.
* Providing HR data, analytics, and reports to assist decision\-making.
* Acting as the first point of contact for employee queries on policies \& procedures
* Overseeing employee training and development programs to enhance skills and career growth.
* Fostering a positive organizational culture that promotes employee engagement, diversity, and inclusion.
* Ensuring compliance with Indian labor laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**


HR Administration \& Compliance

* Create and manage the HR budget, ensuring efficient use of resources.
* Lead and mentor the TA \& Admin team
* Maintain accurate employee data, records, and HRIS updates.
* Ensure compliance with labour laws, statutory requirements, and internal policies.


HR Policy Implementation

* Ensure employees understand and follow HR policies.
* Update policies and communicate changes.
* Analyze HR metrics and reports


Talent Acquisition

* Design and implement talent acquisition strategies that align with the company’s hiring needs
* Work closely with the Talent Acquisition (TA) team to fulfill staffing requirements.
* Own offer negotiation, compensation discussions, and issuance of offer letters.
* Ensure smooth coordination between hiring managers and TA team.


Onboarding, Induction \& Training

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding processes (documentation, systems setup, day\-one coordination).
* Coordinate functional training plans in collaboration with managers and external partners


Employee Relations \& Engagement

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries and grievance resolution.
* Work closely with managers to drive performance conversations and employee development.
* Design initiatives to enhance employee engagement and retention.
* Manage employee relations and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Develop competitive compensation structures and benefits programs.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in HR Management or related field.
* 9\-12 years of experience in HR generalist, HR operations, Talent Acquisition, or similar hands\-on HR roles.
* At least 3 years’ experience leading HR / Admin teams
* Strong understanding of HR processes, Indian labour laws, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in handling onboarding, induction, and training coordination.
* Proficiency in HRIS tools, MS Office, and HR documentation.
* Hands\-on experience in “Workday”
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong negotiation skills for handling offers and compensation discussions.
* High attention to detail \& strong organizational skills
* Demonstrated ability to work hands\-on and get things done
* Experience in developing and managing HR budgets.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural environment.

**Why Trek?**

* Trek Bicycle in Fortune Rankings: (https://fortune.com/company/trek\-bicycle/)
	+ Ranked 4 in Best Large Workplaces in Retail
	+ Ranked 19 in World’s 25 Vest Workplaces
	+ Ranked 50 in Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
	+ Ranked 65 in Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For – Europe

* Group medical insurance floater policy that covers self, spouse, up to 2 children and dependent parents
* 13 Annual paid holidays

By the end of this program, you will be able to design, build, secure, test, and deploy scalable backend applications used in real\-world products.

What You Will Learn1\. Core Backend Foundations

* How backend architecture works
* Understanding client\-server communication
* HTTP methods, status codes, headers

* MVC architecture pattern
* Clean code structure for scalable apps

2\. Deep Dive into Node.js

* Event loop and non\-blocking architecture

* Streams and buffers
* File system operations
* Error handling best practices
* Performance optimization techniques

You will understand how Node.js actually works under the hood, not just how to use it.

3\. Express.js Professional Level

* Advanced routing patterns
* Middleware architecture
* Custom middleware creation
* Request validation and sanitization
* Global error handling
* API versioning strategy

You will learn how to structure production\-grade Express applications.

4\. Database Mastery

* MongoDB with Mongoose (advanced schema design)
* PostgreSQL with Sequelize or Prisma
* Indexing and query optimization
* Data relationships and aggregation pipelines
* Transactions and ACID concepts
* Database performance tuning

5\. Authentication and Security

* JWT authentication (access and refresh tokens)
* Role\-based access control
* OAuth integration
* Password hashing with bcrypt
* Rate limiting and brute\-force protection
* CORS configuration
* Secure API design principles
* OWASP security best practices

You will learn how to build secure backend systems used in real applications.

6\. Advanced API Development

* Pagination, filtering, sorting

* Email and SMS integration
* Payment gateway integration
* API documentation with Swagger
* GraphQL fundamentals
* WebSockets and real\-time applications

7\. Testing and Code Quality

* Unit testing with Jest
* Integration testing
* API testing
* Mocking and stubbing
* Code coverage
* Debugging strategies

8\. DevOps and Deployment

* Environment configuration
* Docker basics for backend
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Deploying to VPS
* Deploying to AWS
* Using PM2 for process management
* Reverse proxy with Nginx

You will learn how to take your backend from local machine to live server.

9\. Microservices and Advanced Architecture

* Monolith vs Microservices
* Service\-to\-service communication
* Message queues (Redis, RabbitMQ)
* Caching strategies
* Load balancing concepts
* Horizontal scaling
* API Gateway pattern

You will understand how large\-scale systems are built.

10\. Performance and Scalability

* Memory management

* Handling high traffic APIs

description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**Senior Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist**
----------------------------------------------------


**Experience**: Minimum 4 years  

**Location**: Koramangala, Bangalore  

**Work Mode**: In\-office  

**Work Schedule**: Its Tuesday to Saturday working, Sunday\-Monday are the week off



Contractual role for 6 months.


### **About the Role**



We are seeking an experienced and hands\-on Senior Recruiter to lead and execute high\-volume hiring initiatives. This role requires strong expertise in bulk hiring, hiring drive management, and the ability to manage and mentor HR interns while working closely with business and operations teams.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Plan, organize, and execute large\-scale hiring drives (virtual and on\-ground).
* Manage bulk hiring for Operations and other frontline roles.
* Lead and manage a team of HR interns, including task allocation, training, and daily performance tracking.
* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment processes: sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding coordination.
* Will be managing a team of HR interns
* Design and roll out attractive and effective employee referral bonus programs to boost hiring outcomes.
* Leverage AI\-based recruitment tools and modern sourcing techniques to improve hiring efficiency (preferred).
* Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand manpower needs, timelines, and priorities.
* Maintain recruitment data, dashboards, and hiring reports for leadership review.

Ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.  
* 

### **Required Qualifications \& Skills**


* Minimum 4 years of experience in recruitment or talent acquisition.
* Strong experience in bulk hiring and hiring drive management, especially for Operations / Sales etc
* Proven experience in managing and mentoring HR interns or junior recruiters.
* Hands\-on experience with ATS platforms and recruitment tools; exposure to AI hiring tools is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and execute lucrative referral programs.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

### **Why Join Us**


* High ownership role with end\-to\-end hiring responsibility
* Opportunity to lead and build a recruitment team
* Fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Direct exposure to leadership and strategic hiring decisions
* Competitive compensation, perks like commute, food
**Our Values**


* **Empathy, Trust \& Candor**  

We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* **Bias for Action**  

We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* **Always Be Learning**  

We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* **Act Like an Owner**  

We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**



Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!



Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.



Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.  

  

Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

At Calfus, we are known for delivering cutting\-edge AI agents and products that transform businesses in ways previously unimaginable. Our software engineering teams are highly valued by customers, whether start\-ups or established enterprises, because we consistently deliver solutions that drive revenue growth. None of this would be possible without talent like you! Our global teams thrive on collaboration, and we’re actively looking for skilled professionals to strengthen our in\-house expertise and help us deliver exceptional AI, software engineering, and solutions using enterprise applications.  

As one of the fastest\-growing companies in our industry, we take pride in fostering a culture of innovation where new ideas are always welcomed—without hesitation. We are driven and expect the same dedication from our team members. Our speed, agility, and dedication set us apart, and we perform best when surrounded by high\-energy, driven individuals.  

To continue our rapid growth and deliver an even greater impact, we invite you to apply for our open positions and become part of our journey! **About the role:**  

We are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee and manage the financial operations of our company. Calfus is headquartered in the US and has India operations in Pune and Bangalore and a subsidiary in Canada. The ideal candidate will play a pivotal role in financial planning, analysis, and decision\-making to ensure the company's financial health and long\-term growth. **What You’ll Do:**  

Financial Planning \& Analysis: \-
* Develop and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial models.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities to optimize costs.
* Provide actionable insights to support strategic decision\-making.

  



Business Partnering: \-
* Baseline key cost levers and collaborate with leaders to establish benchmarks for assisting in pricing, contract structuring, and margin analysis for large deals **including project profitability and profit margin.**
* Collaborate with delivery, sales, HR and other teams to support cross\-functional initiatives.

  



Accounting \& Compliance: \-
* Oversee day\-to\-day accounting operations, including accounts payable/receivable, payroll, and general ledger.
* Spearhead month end, quarter end and year end activities including accruals \& monthly analysis on the actuals vs provisions.
* Ensure compliance with India, US and Canadian tax regulations and financial reporting standards including coordination with auditors for periodic and annual audits.

  



Cash Flow \& Risk Management: \-
* Monitor and manage cash flow to ensure liquidity and operational efficiency.
* Identify financial risks and implement mitigation strategies.

  



Stakeholder Communication: \-
* Prepare and present financial reports to senior management and **closely work with C\-suite and top management directly**
* Collaborate with practice heads to align financial goals with business objectives.

On your first day, we'll expect you to have:  

* Chartered Accountant with 8\+ years of experience in financial management, preferably in the technology services industry.
* Proficiency in financial software (e.g., QuickBooks, Zoho or similar).
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Strong analytical skills and detail orientation. Ability to interpret data, generate and communicate insights.
* Proficient in advanced Microsoft Excel techniques.
* Effective written and oral communication skills with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
* Ability to work independently, maintain confidentiality and collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Individual will need to work across US and India time\-zones.

  


**Benefits:**

At Calfus, we value our employees and offer a strong benefits package. This includes medical, group, and parental insurance, coupled with gratuity and provident fund options. Further, we support employee wellness and provide birthday leave as a valued benefit. **Calfus Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Calfus Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We encourage applications from individuals with diverse experiences and perspectives, as we believe in the power of a diverse and inclusive workforce to drive innovation and success.

title: HR Specialist, Global Operations
description:
**About Command\|Link**

  

Command\|Link is a global SaaS Platform providing network, voice services, and IT security solutions, helping corporations consolidate their core infrastructure into a single vendor and layering on a proprietary single pane of glass platform. Command\|Link has revolutionized the IT industry by tackling the problems our competitors create. In recognition for our unprecedented innovation and dedication, Command\|Link was recognized as the SD\-WAN Product of the Year, ITSM Visionary Spotlight, UCaaS Product of the Year, NaaS Product of the Year, Supplier of the Year, and the AT\&T Strategic Growth Partner. Command\|Link has built the only IT platform for scale that solves ISP vendor sprawl and IT headaches. We make it easy for our customers to get more done, maximize uptime and improve the bottom line.

  

Learn more about us here!

 **This is a 100% remote position!**

 **About your new role:**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented and resourceful HR Specialist to support our growing global workforce across multiple countries. This role plays an important part in ensuring smooth day\-to\-day HR operations for international employees and contractors engaged through global partners and internal HR systems.

  

You’ll work closely with the Director of HR to maintain compliant, organized, and efficient HR processes across regions. This is an operationally focused role for someone who brings structure to fast\-moving environments. While processes exist, priorities can shift quickly, and the right person will be comfortable operating in a growing, startup\-style organization where adaptability, ownership, and responsiveness are essential.

  

Beyond supporting existing processes, you’ll help monitor and strengthen HR automation workflows, identify inefficiencies, and contribute ideas that improve speed, accuracy, and scalability. We’re looking for someone with a systems\-oriented mindset who is comfortable leveraging modern tools, including AI, to enhance productivity and drive smarter HR operations.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a primary HR contact for international employees and contractors, including those engaged through EOR service providers.
* Support onboarding logistics, documentation management, and new hire coordination across HR systems and EOR platforms.
* Maintain and organize employee personnel files, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and proper record retention.
* Assist with drafting offer letters and routing approvals through established workflows.
* Monitor HRIS automated workflows to ensure processes are running properly, troubleshoot issues, and recommend improvements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline processes through automation, AI tools, and system enhancements.
* Support employee benefits coordination and related documentation, including inquiries routed through EOR providers.
* Support time\-off tracking and policy administration.
* Maintain and update HR documentation, knowledge base resources, and organizational reporting (e.g., org charts).
* Track employment law updates in countries where we operate and coordinate with EOR partners as needed.
* Provide recruiting coordination support on an as\-needed basis (e.g., scheduling assistance, posting documentation).
* Assist in planning and coordinating local team\-building initiatives and employee engagement activities within regional teams.
* Perform other duties and projects as assigned to support the HR function and broader organization.
* Takes on additional responsibilities and projects as needed to support the success of the team and organization.

 **What you'll need for success:**

* 2–4 years of experience in Human Resources or People Operations.
* Experience supporting international employees through EOR service providers (e.g., Deel) preferred.
* Exposure to multi\-country workforce operations and global compliance considerations.
* Foundational knowledge of HR compliance and employment law.
* Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., Rippling) and comfort navigating multiple systems.
* Highly detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills.
* Process\-driven mindset with the ability to follow structured workflows while thinking critically about improvements.
* Strong sense of data integrity, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive employee information.
* Comfort using technology to improve efficiency, with curiosity around automation and AI\-driven tools.
* Resourceful, creative problem\-solver who can think beyond “how it’s always been done.”
* Strong written communication skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

 **Why you'll love life at Command\|Link**


Join us at CommandLink, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of business communication. We value the innovative spirit and seek individuals ready to bring their unique vision and expertise to a team that values bold ideas and strategic thinking. Are you ready to make an impact?

* Room to grow at a high\-growth company
* An environment that celebrates ideas and innovation
* Your work will have a tangible impact
* Flexible time off
* Fun events at cool locations
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team

  

At CommandLink, we’re committed to creating a fair, consistent, and efficient hiring experience. As part of our process, we use AI\-assisted tools to help review and analyze applications. These tools support our recruiting team by identifying qualifications and experience that align with the requirements of each role.

  

AI tools are used only to assist in the evaluation process — they do not make final hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by a member of our recruiting or hiring team before any decisions are made.

Join us as a Talent Attraction Lead, Employer Brand \& Talent Attraction

* As the Talent Attraction Lead for India, you’ll be joining the global Employer Brand \& Talent Attraction team at an exciting time of change
* You’ll be part of a talented, collaborative team shaping how we attract the people who continually delivery for our customers. You’ll have the opportunity to innovate, work with senior stakeholders, and directly influence the success of our employer brand \& talent attraction strategy in India.

What you'll do

  

As the Talent Attraction Lead for India, you’ll take the lead in delivering high quality, insight driven recruitment campaigns across the region. Working closely with our global channel, employer brand, content and digital teams, you’ll ensure our attraction activity is measurable, effective and aligned to business needs.

* Act as a key partner to Talent Acquisition teams and business stakeholders, including partnering with India Internal Communications and Inclusion teams on cross\-functional activity.

* Support wider team processes, ways of working, and quality control activities.


The skills you'll need

  

We’re looking for someone with a strong and proven background in employer brand and recruitment marketing. You’ll have excellent stakeholder management, influencing and collaboration skills, and a proven ability to work in a pressurised environment to very tight deadlines.

  

You’ll also have:

* Strong understanding of campaign planning, digital marketing and achieving measurable business outcomes.
* Knowledge of digital and direct marketing, including programmatic, CRM, social media and content marketing.
* Excellent project management skills with the ability to work at pace and adapt to changing needs.

* Ability to gather and analyse data to make informed recommendations.
* Exceptional attention to detail in written and visual content and the ability to follow and interpret brand guidelines.
* Experience in marketing or recruitment marketing in a global and/or financial services experience is an advantage.

description:
**All roles at JumpCloud are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** **About JumpCloud**
JumpCloud® delivers a unified open directory platform that makes it easy to securely manage identities, devices, and access across your organization. With JumpCloud®, IT teams and MSPs enable users to work securely from anywhere and manage their Windows, Apple, Linux, and Android devices from a single platform. JumpCloud® is IT Simplified. **About the Role:**Are you a systems\-thinker who loves the intersection of People Operations and Technology? As a Senior HR Coordinator at JumpCloud, you will go beyond traditional administration. You will be a key driver in our HR Shared Services model, owning critical workstreams and leveraging a modern tech stack to create a seamless, scalable employee experience. We are looking for someone who doesn't just follow a process but looks for ways to automate, optimize, and elevate it.  


### **In this role, you will:**

* + Independently manage and own the end\-to\-end execution of employee lifecycle events, including global onboarding, offboarding, performance management and benefits administration.
	+ Act as the Tier 2 support lead for complex HR operational queries, ensuring high\-quality service delivery across the organization.
	+ Proactively apply and reinforce company and regional policies, ensuring all HR initiatives enable company strategy at a functional level.
	+ Navigate and maintain data integrity across our core platforms: ADP (Workforce Now), Deel, Jira and our HRIS ecosystem.
	+ Own the digital filing architecture, ensuring compliance and ease of access for the global HR team.
	+ Utilize SRM to manage HR service requests, track workflows, and ensure SLA compliance.
	+ Identify manual inefficiencies within established HR processes and recommend/implement automated solutions to enhance speed and accuracy.
	+ Demonstrate negotiation and influence skills to build alignment with external stakeholders and internal partners.
	+ Conducting periodic HR compliance audits, leverage deep knowledge of local labor laws to support standardized and legally sound operational processes.
	+ Utilize HR dashboards and reports to monitor trends, validate data integrity, and identify potential risks.
	+ Use key HR metrics to propose thoughtful, scalable improvements to workflows that directly impact business outcomes.
	+ At JumpCloud, we value "Progress over Perfection." You will have the autonomy to identify a "broken" process and the support to fix it using the latest HR tools and automation techniques.

### **You Have:**

* + 4\+ years in HR Operations or Shared Services, preferably in a high\-growth tech environment.
	+ Ability to manage moderately complex tasks with minimal supervision.
	+ A natural curiosity for how HR processes connect to the broader organization.
	+ A proven track record of troubleshooting issues and initiating small\-scale projects to streamline workflows.
	+ Ability to exercise discretion, sound judgment, and diplomacy when communicating with everyone from new hires to Senior Management.
	+ Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing at all levels in the organization including Senior Management.
	+ Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, sound judgment, tact and diplomacy in all communications. Analytical and process oriented
	+ Experience maintaining confidentiality of assignments due to the exposure to sensitive information and contacts
	+ High level of proficiency in Microsoft Excel (vlookups, pivots), Word, PowerPoint, Gsuite, and a passion for learning new HR software.
	+ Experience with Jira (for ticketing/workflows), ADP, and Deel will be a plus.
	+ HRMS experience is a plus, or technically savvy and willingness to learn many systems.

\#LI\-YI1 **Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. **This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**  

**Language:**JumpCloud® has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. **Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.  

  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. **Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at \[email protected] with the subject line "Scam Notice"  

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. title: Sales Counsellor (Study Abroad) |Full-Time, Remote (IST)
description:
Job description
 



 ApplyAZ is transforming the study\-abroad experience, helping students access tuition\-free degree paths in Italy for both bachelor’s and master’s programs.
 



 We’re hiring a Sales Counsellor (Full\-Cycle) to own the journey from first contact to payment and successful onboarding. You’ll speak with high\-intent leads, run video consultations, handle objections, close enrollments, and keep students moving confidently to the next step and other teams.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Full\-cycle conversion: Own the funnel end\-to\-end: qualify → consult → follow\-up → close → collect → onboarding kickoff.
 



 Consult and close: Run video calls, explain the offer clearly (timeline, documents, fees, expectations), and convert to paid enrollment.
 



 Multi\-channel selling: Close via phone, WhatsApp, email, and video call with fast response time and disciplined follow\-up.
 



 Objection handling: Confidently handle concerns on fees, safety, fit, timelines, and “why Italy.”
 



 CRM excellence: Maintain clean CRM hygiene: stages, tags, notes, next steps, activity logging, sequences, and daily reporting.

description:
Please find the below details for your ref

**Role** \- Mechanical Design Engineer \- Robotic Arm

**Location**: Bangalore South (**Jigani**)

**Work mode**: On\-site (preferred) / Hybrid (as applicable)

**Experience**: 1 – 5 years (Max)

**Domain**: Industrial Robotics / Autonomous Manipulation

**Company Overview:**

Rx100 Ventures is a sector\-focused deep tech venture firm headquartered in Bangalore, India. We partner with startups at the intersection of industrial innovation, deep tech, and digital transformation, providing capital and strategic direction to accelerate their growth.

**About the Role**

We’re building an Autonomous Industrial Robotic Arm in the 5–7 DOF range with payload \<250 kg and hiring a Mechanical Design Engineer to take hardware from concept → CAD → prototype → validation → production release. This is a hands\-on role focused on precision mechanisms and joint module engineering, not general CAD drafting.

**What You’ll Do** 

· Design arm joints, links, housings/covers, and end\-effector mechanical interfaces for a multi\-DOF industrial arm

· Own joint module design: BLDC motor \+ harmonic/planetary gearbox integration, bearing/shaft/fastener sizing, housing architecture, sealing (IP\-rated where required), thermal paths/heat sinking, and robust cable routing/strain relief

· Create production\-grade engineering drawings: GD\&T, datums, fits, tolerance stack\-ups, and release packs (BOM \+ rev control)

· Support prototype builds and iteration cycles: assembly debugging, RCA, fixture/jig requirements, reliability improvements

· Drive DFM/DFA with suppliers (machining, sheet metal, castings, heat\-treat, surface finishing), RFQs, and drawing clarifications

· Collaborate with controls/electronics/firmware teams on packaging constraints, sensor mounts, and mechatronic interfaces.

**Must\-Have Requirements** 

· 1 plus years of mechanical design experience in robotics / industrial automation / precision machinery / mechatronics

· Strong fundamentals: mechanisms, materials, manufacturing, fits \& tolerances

· Proficiency in 3D CAD \+ drawings

· CAD: Autodesk Fusion 360 / Autodesk Inventor and/or SolidWorks / Creo / NX

· Drawings: GD\&T, tolerance stack\-up, datum strategy

· Experience with actuator \& transmission integration: motors/gearboxes, bearings, shafts, housings, fasteners

**Good\-to\-Have** 

· Experience with robot arms (5–7 axis), heavy/industrial manipulators, or servo\-driven jointed mechanisms

· Familiarity with harmonic drive / planetary gearbox / cycloidal concepts, encoder integration, lubrication, serviceability

· Working knowledge of FEA/CAE (e.g., ANSYS or equivalent) for stiffness/deflection and basic modal checks

· Exposure to IP sealing, thermal management around motors/drives, and production validation practices

**This Role Is NOT For**

Profiles limited to 2D drafting or architecture/interiors/civil CAD

Pure simulation\-only roles without ownership of mechanical design deliverables

Freshers / interns

ROS / ROS2 development

Move It, Gazebo\-based simulation work

SLAM or autonomous navigation systems

Computer Vision implementation

AI / ML\-centric roles

Pure software engineering roles

Simulation\-only responsibilities without physical product ownership

title: Community Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Calyp is a deep\-tech startup, based in Germany, building next\-generation human–computer interaction products at the intersection of brain–computer interface (BCI), consumer technology, and Augmented Reality (AR).

We are transitioning from a research\-focused phase into a consumer\-facing brand, and we are looking for someone who can help us grow a lively, authentic, and engaging online community around our story, products, and vision.

This role is best suited for someone who enjoys creating content, interacting with people online, and thinking like a digital community builder rather than a traditional marketer.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Community \& Social Presence Builder who loves the internet culture of content, conversations, and creator\-driven growth.

This is a hands\-on, early\-stage startup role where you will have the freedom to experiment, build your creative style, and directly shape how people see and interact with Calyp online.

If you are someone who already creates content, enjoys social media trends, tech enthusiast or wants to grow as a digital creator, this role will feel natural to you.

**What You Will Do**

**Community Building \& Engagement**

* Grow and energise Calyp’s presence on platforms such as LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Discord, and other relevant communities
* Actively engage with followers, comments, and discussions
* Help build a positive, curious, and vibrant community around technology and innovation
* Moderate and participate in community conversations

**Content \& Creator\-Style Storytelling**

* Ideate and create engaging posts, reels, and short\-form content
* Create engaging content around tech, startups and innovation
* Think in terms of hooks, storytelling, and shareable ideas
* Support launch campaigns, product updates, and founder insights
* Maintain a consistent but human and authentic brand voice

**Community Communication \& Updates**

* Help prepare newsletters and updates
* Coordinate content from research, product, and founder teams

**Basic Marketing \& Outreach Support**

* Prepare simple marketing materials (presentations, one\-pagers, outreach messages)
* Assist with simple CRM or lead coordination (training will be provided)

**Who We Are Looking For**

* Someone genuinely excited about social media, communities, and online conversations
* Creator mindset \> corporate marketing mindset
* Comfortable using Instagram, X, and LinkedIn
* Good written communication skills in English
* Self\-driven and reliable

*No prior corporate experience is required.*

**Big Plus If You**

* Create content on any platform (influencer, creator, or hobby page is fine)
* Have managed a brand, club, or community page before
* Understand engagement psychology — hooks, trends, and audience interaction
* Are curious about startups, technology, or innovation culture

**What You Get**

* Ownership of social and community presence for a growing startup
* Direct mentorship from founders
* Freedom to experiment creatively
* Opportunity to grow into a higher responsibility and compensation role as Calyp scales

As a Human Resources (HR) intern at Protalk Solutions Pvt. Ltd., you will have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment. Your role will involve supporting the HR team in various tasks and projects related to recruitment, employee relations, and training and development.
   

  

* Assist in the recruitment process by posting job openings, scheduling interviews, and conducting initial screenings of candidates.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding processes, including preparing new hire paperwork and conducting exit interviews.
* Assist in organizing and facilitating training and development programs for employees.
* Support the HR team in maintaining employee records and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Help with employee engagement initiatives, such as organizing team\-building activities and events.
* Assist in conducting performance evaluations and providing feedback to employees.
* Collaborate with other departments to support HR\-related initiatives and projects.


 If you are a motivated and detail\-oriented individual with a strong command of spoken English, this internship will provide you with valuable exposure to the field of human resources and the opportunity to develop essential skills for a successful HR career. Join our team and make a meaningful impact on our organization!
   

  

 About Company: At Protalk, we deliver extraordinary services with a team of trained professionals in consulting, contact center services, robotics, automation, and AI technology solutions. We offer our clients the most cutting\-edge and innovative business services available. Our digital solutions are designed to help the country's top brands streamline their operations and run more efficiently than ever before. With our help, our clients can achieve meaningful and sustainable growth and achieve their goals effectively and responsibly. Whether you want to streamline your supply chain, optimize your marketing efforts, or enhance your customer experience, we have the tools and expertise to help you succeed.

title: Human Resources Intern
description:

 **Human Resources Intern** 
 , you will get hands\-on exposure to how an HR team works in a growing digital marketing company. This role is designed for freshers who are curious about people management and eager to learn through real experience.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**HR Generalist** 




**Location:** 
 Kandla, Gujarat
 



**Reports To:** 
 Functionally to Group Vice President\-HR; Administratively to Terminal Head
 



  





**Job Summary** 




 The HR Generalist will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day human resource operations, statutory compliance, and labour relations in line with applicable labour laws and factory regulations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




**Statutory Compliance \& Labour Law Administration** 



* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of statutory licences and registrations under the Factories Act and related rules.
* Manage submission of statutory returns such as Form 11A and other applicable forms.
* Administer and monitor compliance with Minimum Wages Act, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, and Payment of Gratuity, PF, Bonus and other related legislations.
* Maintain and implement Model Standing Orders and ensure adherence to internal policies in line with statutory requirements.
* Handle provisions under the Industrial Disputes Act (ID Act) including Notice of Change and Settlement procedures.
* Coordinate and represent the company during inspections by statutory and labour authorities.



  





**Employee Relations \& HR Operations** 



* Oversee time office routines, including attendance, leave, and overtime (OT) management.
* Manage leave administration and leave encashment processes as per company policy and statutory norms.
* Maintain employee records, personal files, and statutory registers.
* Handle grievance redressal, employee discipline, and counsel employees to maintain a positive work environment.
* Support the HR HOD in implementing employee engagement initiatives and welfare activities.



  





**Discipline \& Industrial Relations** 



* Support enforcement of company rules and standing orders to maintain workplace discipline.
* Assist in handling employee misconduct cases and preliminary inquiries in coordination with the management.
* Participate in settlement negotiations and assist in drafting and maintaining records of agreements.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Education: Graduate / Postgraduate in HR, Industrial Relations, or Labour Welfare.
* Experience: 8 to 12 years of experience in HR operations or compliance, preferably in a manufacturing or plant environment.
* Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of Indian labour laws, factory compliance, and HR administrative procedures.



  





**Skills \& Competencies**



* Strong knowledge of statutory labour laws and compliance.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and HRMS/payroll software.
* Attention to detail, integrity, and ability to handle confidential information.

title: Human Resources Manager  with L&D Focus (Contract Position)
description:
At Veremark, we’re redefining trust in hiring and workforce verification through cutting\-edge technology, data integrity, and a people\-first mindset. With a global footprint, we help businesses build trusted relationships — starting from every hire.
 



  





 As part of our fast\-growing and globally connected team, you’ll join a company that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, set high standards, and believe that great teams are built on transparency, accountability, and shared success.
 



  





 At Veremark, you’ll have the opportunity to shape scalable HR practices, enhance the employee experience across regions, and play a key role in supporting our mission to make hiring fairer, faster, and more reliable for organizations around the world.
 



  





 Join us if you’re ready to make an impact, drive meaningful change, and grow your HR career in a company that truly values people as its greatest asset.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 We’re looking for a dynamic UK/India HR Manager with Learning and Development focus, and people experience for our growing workforce. This role blends operational excellence with strategic HR partnership — from training to payroll and benefits governance to employee engagement, compensation frameworks, and performance programs across multiple countries. This role will also own and deliver high\-impact learning experiences across Veremark, including creating the framework, strategies, contents deliverables (partnering with key business owners) and delivering the training.
 



 As the UK/India HR Manager, you will lead HR operations with Learning and Development/Training focus and strategic people initiatives across the UK, India workforces, with potential expansion into newer geographies in Europe. You will be responsible for compliance, employee lifecycle management, and partnering with business leaders to drive talent strategies aligned with Veremark’s growth.
 



  





**Duties and Responsibilities** 




 Employee Lifecycle Management
 


* Support employee life cycle activities from on\-boarding, day to day support, to off\-boarding stages
* Offer support and guidance to employees on HR policies, procedures, welfare and benefits programs, insurance claims, and other HR\-related administrative matters
* Manage and maintain each new hire’s personal folder from the pre\-onboarding phase through the end of their probation period
* Promote a positive work environment through employee initiatives and to create a holistic employee experience
* Manage benefits in kind such as birthdays, special occasions, work anniversaries etc.
* Act as a point of contact for employee HR\-related queries
* Review, develop, update, and implement HR policies, procedures, and the employee handbook to ensure compliance with labour laws and regulation
* Oversee the annual insurance renewal process and monthly update to vendor



  





 HR Training and System Management
 


* Build and develop internal training framework, content, and structure
* Analyze training, learning and development gaps within the organization
* Assist in planning, sourcing and publishing/promoting internally learning and development programs
* Serve as the primary training coordinator/trainer within HR, handling the scheduling of sessions while collaborating with HR counterparts to ensure invitations for sessions and other key events are properly distributed
* Facilitate training sessions for local employees/workers on various contents such as client onboarding, sales training, HR systems, tools, and outward mindset initiatives; company cultures; or as assigned.
* Partner with IT to ensure security trainings are 100% completion rate



  





 Merger and Acquisition
 


* Act as the catalyst for cultural integration across UK entities and newly acquired businesses, post\-integration, ensuring alignment with Veremark’s Core Values and operating principles.
* Lead the people and culture integration strategy during mergers and acquisition, conducting cultural diagnostics, identifying gaps, and designing structured integration roadmaps.
* Serve as the HR change agent, driving organisational alignment, harmonisation of policies, and consistent employee experience across merged entities.
* Bridge cultural, operational, and behavioural differences by facilitating and alignment workshops, communication frameworks, and change engagement initiatives.
* Partner with executive stakeholders to unify teams under a shared identity, shared goals, and common performance standards.



  





 Compensation Strategy \& Framework
 


* Ability to design and support a competitive global compensation framework, covering fixed pay and variable incentive programs.
* Develop and implement internal salary bands and job grading structures aligned with market dynamics, balancing standardization and flexibility.
* Conduct market research and benchmarking to continuously enhance compensation competitiveness.
* Support VP of People \& Culture to develop diverse incentive programs aligned with company growth and workforce needs.
* Monitor program effectiveness and optimize reward mechanisms to enhance business impact and employee engagement.
* Develop diverse incentive programs aligned with company growth and workforce needs.
* Monitor program effectiveness and optimize reward mechanisms to enhance business impact and employee engagement
